case_name: Smt Vanitha K P W/O J Sreenath vs Sri J Sreenath S/O Late Jayaramaiah

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Vanitha K P W/O J Sreenath (wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: Sri J Sreenath S/O Late Jayaramaiah (husband)

facts_of_case: The parties were married on 12-11-09 and have a female child born on 31-10-10. The petitioner is living with her parents at Bhadravathi due to misunderstandings, while the respondent resides in Bangalore. The respondent has instituted M.C.3735/10 under Section 13(1)(i-a) of the Hindu Marriage Act against the petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer to establish sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: However, the fact remains that, the petitioner is residing at Bhadravathi, which is about 270 Kms away from Bangalore. The petitioner with a small kid will not be able to attend

legal_principles.principle: The court's discretion in granting transfer is guided by the principle that the convenience of the parties should be considered.
legal_principles.held: This petition has been filed to transfer the said case to the Court of disposal.

outcome.final_order: The petition is allowed and M.C.3735/10 pending in the Court of Additional Family Judge, Bangalore is transferred to the Court of Principal Civil Judge (SR.DN), Bhadravathi.

use_for_drafting: seeking withdrawal and transfer of divorce petition
